learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn the magic tricks of borrowing and carrying over to add and subtract big numbers!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: When we add big numbers and get more than 9 in the ones place, we pack ten of them into a bag and carry it over to the tens place!
If we want to subtract but the top number is too small, we can knock on the tens door and borrow a ten to make our number bigger!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 The Borrowing Bank
fun_activity.instructions: Use bundles of 10 matchsticks and loose ones. Try subtracting 15 from 32 by breaking open a bundle of 10 to get enough loose sticks!

quick_recap: ⭐ We carry over when addition makes our numbers too big for one room.
⭐ We borrow from the next column when we do not have enough to subtract.
